name: language-bridge
description: Type in your own language; the model reads English, and its English replies are shown translated back.

language.title: Language
language.description: Your language as a BCP-47 code (zh-CN, ja, ko, fr, ...). en turns translation off.

provider.title: Translator
provider.description: auto: the API when a key is set, else the fake translator. api: always call the API (also keyless local servers such as Ollama). fake: only tag the text, for testing.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for the translation service. Left empty, LANGUAGE_BRIDGE_API_KEY (then SILICONFLOW_API_KEY) is read from the environment.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model to translate with, as the service names it.

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL; /chat/completions is appended unless the URL already ends with it.

thinkingFormat.title: Thinking off
thinkingFormat.description: How the service is told to skip thinking, so a translation comes back fast. qwen: enable_thinking (SiliconFlow, Qwen). deepseek, zai: thinking.type (DeepSeek, Zhipu). openrouter: reasoning.effort. together: reasoning.enabled. chat-template: chat_template_kwargs (vLLM, SGLang). none: send nothing (OpenAI, Ollama).

extraBody.title: Extra request fields
extraBody.description: A JSON object merged into every request body, for anything else a service needs. It may override the thinking field and temperature, never the model, stream or messages.
